evidenceClass: Existing static source inspection; not a live network audit or runtime build identification
scenario: Admin matches search/status FILTER and detail browser-Back restoration

sourceOnlyFindings.finding: Search input calls onSearchChange(value). Filter chips are type=button and call onStatusChange(option.value). These controls do not submit a moderation form.

setSearch and setActiveStatus merge against latestDraft, reset page to 1, and immediately use history.replaceState for q/status/page while preserving other query/hash fields. Only API search is trimmed and debounced by 300 ms. Back/Forward or an external URL change restores draft and debounced search immediately; stale URL snapshots are ignored and timers cleaned up.

List useQuery calls v1Get('/admin/matches', filters), and detail useQuery calls v1Get('/admin/matches/:matchId'). v1Get explicitly uses method GET. There is no recordSearch call in the inspected filter/query/list/detail chain. The separate useV1RecordSearch hook posts /search/recent but is not called by this chain.

Backend @Get('matches') and @Get('matches/:matchId') delegate to AdminService listMatches/getMatch. These perform active-admin lookup and read queries (findMany/groupBy or findUnique), then return data. No business mutation or search-history write appears in these methods or getActiveAdmin.

Row selection router.pushes the detail route. The detail page's visible 목록 link points to bare /admin/matches, so browser Back is the appropriate mechanism to verify restoration of q/status. The detail page itself mounts a GET hook and provides read rendering/refetch/navigation.

separateBusinessMutation.finding: The row action 상태 변경 opens the moderation modal. handleModalSubmit invokes changeStatusMutation.mutate; useV1ChangeMatchStatus POSTs /admin/matches/:id/status with status/reason. Search/status FILTER controls are distinct from this business write.

testSourceEvidence.status: Inspected existing test source only; tests were not executed.
testSourceEvidence.coverage: URL hydration; 1.0.3+completed→detail→real history Back/Forward; rapid search/status merge; 300ms debounce; unchanged history length; preserved unrelated query/hash; stale timer cancellation; page reset; invalid parameters; ordinary empty result versus API error.

errorTelemetryException.finding: Shared v1Api reports unexpected non-OK/API-error responses via reportClientError. That reporter can POST /api/v1/logs/client-error with keepalive. Therefore successful normal search/filter/detail/empty-result paths are read-only business behavior, but 'zero POST under every condition' is not established.

limits: No forced API error was tested.
Existing tests were inspected, not executed for this packet.
The list/detail business read path is not proof that all surrounding traffic is GET or that no server writes occurred.
